relations.rationale: Jude showing up last is consistent with and explains why Jude might be out of breath from rushing, making it more plausible.
Jude arriving last doesn't inherently imply what topic Jude was talking about afterward.
Jude showing up last has no bearing on whether Milo passed around a sign-up sheet.
Jude's breathlessness from rushing has nothing to do with where Milo chose to sit.
Jude being out of breath from a seminar is unrelated to Noor's choice of a mystery novel.
Being out of breath from rushing after a late seminar supports the idea that Jude would still be talking about that seminar.
Rushing after a late seminar supports the idea that the seminar's argument ran past schedule, causing lateness.
Jude's breathlessness has no connection to the order in which Otto and Kira signed a sheet.

Milo picking seats near the window and arranging chairs for visibility of new arrivals are both plausible actions but not directly implying each other, and could even be seen as different arrangements.
Milo's seat choice has no bearing on Noor's height.
Milo arranging chairs for viewing arrivals is unrelated to Otto and Kira's class enrollment.
Milo's chair arrangement is unrelated to the order of signing the sheet.
Otto and Kira sharing a class has no bearing on Milo's reaction to a suggestion.

If Otto is in the same class as Kira, and Kira is not in the same class as Jude, this is consistent but doesn't directly support or contradict; the claim about Otto/Kira doesn't establish anything about Kira/Jude directly.
Otto being in the same class as Kira is compatible with Otto not being in the same class as Jude, and if Kira is not in the same class as Jude, this makes the claim more consistent, supporting it.
Otto and Kira walking to the library together is unrelated to Milo's age relative to Kira.
Noor's mention of choosing a mystery novel is the suggestion that Milo nodded approvingly at, supporting the connection.
Milo nodding approvingly at a suggestion is unrelated to him passing around a sign-up sheet.
Milo's approving nod has no bearing on his age relative to Otto.
Kira not being in Jude's class is consistent with Otto also not being in Jude's class, but doesn't directly establish it.
